test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 2 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was the first B vitamin discovered in 1897?
solution: The correct answer is __Thiamine__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Thiamine, also known as thiamin or Vitamin B1. • It was the first B vitamin discovered in 1897 • It is found in food-dried milk, nuts, oats, oranges, pork, eggs, etc. • As a supplement, it is used to treat and prevent thiamine deficiency and disorders that result from it including Beriberi, Korsakoff's syndrome, and Korsakoff's psychosis. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Name of the Vitamin__ __Chemical Name__ __Function__ __Deficiency__
